items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I played with Nino Protruno's band

ctx.x: And, as I said to you - I think it was yesterday, I said something happened to me there that has never happened before in my whole lifetime. When I finished the concert, they screamed and yelled for an encore which, of course, I did; there was about 700 from school kids on up to the faculty--- they were all in there and so I did another encore and I had a hell of a time getting back to my dressing room because it was so filled with people and on my way through the crowd they all stood up - I don't know whether…
life. And, of course, you know, I played in Italy - I played with Nino Protruno's band and he is T.V. star ---
